notes: Timeline: each scene block now has a ▾ caret that expands an inline editor for that scene's items (voice/text/media/sfx) — drag a bar's right edge to change its length or its body to move its timing; caret flips to ▴ to close, and blocks stay resizable/movable. New 'All scenes / Focus scene' toggle in the timeline header to step out of single-scene editing and view every scene. (Transform box already hugs shapes/images the same way it does text.)
